jobs.title: Information Technology Manager (Hands on)
jobs.description:
IT Manager / Senior Systems Administrator (Hands-On Player-Coach)

$23B Hedge Fund | NYC with travel to CT | 100% Onsite, 5 Days

$200–250K base | $325–350K total comp | US Citizens Only

A long-tenured IT leader is retiring, and this firm needs a hands-on player-coach to step in. It is not a people-manager seat. You'll still do the senior systems work every day while leading and mentoring a small desktop support team. The environment is about 85% Windows and 15% Linux, supporting roughly 170 people.
What you'll own
Active Directory and Entra ID: group design, service accounts, SPNs, app registrations, Graph API access and credential rotation
Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online: mail routing, mail security, DLP, retention, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive
VMware vSphere and the Windows Server estate, plus physical servers (racking, cabling, diagnostics, part swaps)
Windows and Samba file servers: permissions, quotas, capacity and migrations
Networking and firewalls: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, wireless, certificates and monitoring
Security: endpoint protection, MFA, conditional access, phishing simulations and alert response
IT controls in an audited environment: monthly access reviews, change management, exceptions and DDQ support
eDiscovery and legal hold searches with Legal and Compliance
Avaya PBX support and the move to an outsourced voice provider
Licensing, renewals and vendor management (M365, Adobe, Box, Bloomberg, Verizon and more)
Server room power and cooling: UPS, PDUs, HVAC and coordination with building vendors
PowerShell and Python automation
Leading and mentoring the desktop support team and serving as the top technical escalation point

What you bring
7+ years of hands-on enterprise infrastructure experience
Deep Windows Server, AD, M365 and MFA knowledge
Real experience with service accounts, Entra app registrations and credential management
VMware vSphere
A secure email gateway such as Proofpoint or Mimecast
Endpoint and data-governance tools such as CrowdStrike or Varonis
Strong PowerShell
Experience running IT controls in a regulated or audited setting
Experience leading projects with MSPs and vendors from start to finish

Nice to have
Financial services background
eDiscovery or legal hold experience
Bloomberg administration and entitlements
Avaya PBX experience
AWS or Azure
Ansible or PowerShell DSC

The details
100% onsite in NYC, with travel to CT and the firm's Westchester DR site as needed (transportation covered)
Occasional after-hours work for patching and recovery testing
US citizens only

If you're a doer who also likes to lead, message me directly.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Interim Director of IT Operations & Transformation
Client:
University of South Carolina
Location:
Columbia, South Carolina
Work Arrangement:
Hybrid – 3 days onsite per week
Contract Duration:
6 months, with possible extension
Interview Process:
One in-person interview
Job ID:
13921
Position Overview
The University of South Carolina is seeking an experienced technology leader to provide interim leadership, stabilize departmental operations, and drive organizational transformation within its research computing and IT services environment.
The successful candidate will assess current operations, strengthen organizational culture and accountability, align resources with institutional priorities, and implement sustainable management and governance practices while preparing the department for a permanent Director.
Key Responsibilities
Lead departmental operations, research technology infrastructure, and related IT services.
Supervise managers, professional staff, and student employees.
Establish performance expectations and monitor organizational outcomes.
Make timely operational and resource-allocation decisions.
Lead organizational change initiatives and culture transformation.
Evaluate organizational effectiveness and recommend structural improvements.
Develop departmental priorities and performance metrics with executive leadership.
Coordinate departmental budgets and strategic resource allocation.
Ensure compliance with university policies, security standards, audit requirements, and applicable regulations.
Resolve organizational obstacles affecting productivity, innovation, and collaboration.
Prepare executive-level reports, assessments, and recommendations.
Develop succession plans and transition documentation for the incoming permanent Director.
Inventory existing research technology infrastructure, services, procedures, projects, and budget needs.
Improve customer engagement, support-request tracking, communications, reporting, and operational processes.
Establish governance, communication, and decision-making practices that support long-term success.
Mentor team members and support professional development where appropriate.

Mandatory Qualifications
Completed bachelor's degree.
8+ years of experience leading organizational transformation, change management, and service-delivery optimization.
8+ years of experience leading large, complex technology projects.
8+ years of experience in personnel management, coaching, and performance accountability.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with research cyberinfrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC), high-speed storage, and networking technologies.
Experience implementing governance and operational-maturity frameworks.
Experience managing organizational change in higher education.
Master's degree in science, technology, or a related field.
ITIL knowledge or certification.
Cloud infrastructure experience with AWS and/or Azure.
AI infrastructure experience involving AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Carpentries Instructor experience.
Training or experience with HPC technologies such as Slurm and InfiniBand.

Location Requirements
Candidates must currently reside in South Carolina, North Carolina, or Georgia and be willing to relocate to South Carolina at their own expense before starting the assignment, as required to meet the hybrid work arrangement.
How to Apply
Interested candidates should submit an updated resume highlighting their executive-level IT leadership, organizational transformation, service-delivery improvement, personnel management, and technology project leadership experience.
